name: COLD GAS
tagline: Ten thrusters. One roll. Stick the landing.

capture.notes: Real flights through the real UI, Debug build on a slowed clock: ios/scripts/store-capture.py (see its header). 6.9-inch simulator for raw/iphone; an open Duo simulator's inner screen (SHOT_DISPLAY=primary-1) for raw/duo. A person picks the frames.

shots.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
shots.sub: Ten cold-gas thrusters. One roll. One mark to land on.

shots.title: Hold to fly. *Let go upside down.*
shots.sub: Assist flies the valves. You choose when to go.

shots.title: Three judges. *No excuses.*
shots.sub: A fixed scorer decides the numbers. The judges only supply the words.

shots.title: Feel *every wheel* land.
shots.sub: A synced landing is one clean thump. A sloppy one is four.

shots.title: Climb it. *Hang there.*
shots.sub: Up the curl on suction and under the ledge, then let go.

shots.title: Fly *ten valves* by hand.
shots.sub: Assist, Pro, Advanced: take away the computer one tier at a time.

shots.title: Roll it *over the line.*
shots.sub: Off the kicker at dusk, a barrel roll, wheels down.

shots.title: Open it. *Fly it.*
shots.sub: Edge to edge when open. In tabletop, the top half is the screen and the bottom half the controller.

feature.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
feature.sub: Ten thrusters. One roll. Three judges.
